references.text: Also describes a scene where the wicked are punished with fire
Speaks of weeping and gnashing of teeth in connection with the punishment for the wicked
Mentions again weeping and gnashing of teeth as punishment for those who are cast out
Describes the punishment for the wicked with weeping and gnashing of teeth
Yet another reference to weeping and gnashing of teeth as punishment for the wicked
Describes an eternal fire as punishment for the devil, the beast, and the false prophet
Refers to the lake of fire as the second death, where those not written in the book of life are cast
